inputs.question: If notice is served on 4 December 2026, when does a 21-day period end?

slots.name: ANSWER
slots.text: The period ends on Monday 28 December 2026

slots.name: WHY
slots.text: 21 days after 4 December is Friday 25 December, a public holiday; 26 December is a holiday and a Saturday and 27 December a Sunday, so it rolls to the next day that is none of these

slots.name: RULE
slots.text: as § 3(a) and (b) say

known.reference: The period ends on Monday 28 December 2026; 21 days after 4 December is Friday 25 December, a public holiday; 26 December is a holiday and a Saturday and 27 December a Sunday, so it rolls to the next day that is none of these; as § 3(a) and (b) say.
